title: Jonah and the Oath Revisited
author: J. M. Quintana
blurb: Petra Hartwell, an exiled storm-caller, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
